steps.en: OCMS shows the notice number and defendant details after saving
steps.id: OCMS menampilkan notice dan data defendant setelah simpan
steps.why_en: It is the general notice page, not a dedicated confirmation screen.
steps.why_id: Ini halaman notice umum, bukan layar konfirmasi khusus.

steps.en: OCMS shows the newly saved defendant address
steps.id: OCMS menampilkan alamat defendant yang baru disimpan
steps.why_en: It shows the notice address; the court record is not updated.
steps.why_id: Yang tampil alamat notice; data court tidak diubah.

steps.en: Officer confirms to proceed with sending the Letter of Advice
steps.id: Officer mengonfirmasi lanjut kirim Letter of Advice
steps.why_en: The only confirm dialog is for saving the address, not for the Letter of Advice.
steps.why_id: Dialog konfirmasi yang ada untuk simpan alamat, bukan Letter of Advice.
